label: Food & grocery
note: The facts that matter on a packet are on the packet, and nowhere else a shopper can search. Ingredients in declared order, nutrition per 100 g, additives, allergens, veg or non-veg. Open Food Facts already holds much of this for India under ODbL — this schema is shaped to receive it without loss.

quantity.label: Net quantity
quantity.note: As printed on the pack — '45 g', '1 L'. Kept as text because packs say '2 x 75 g' and that is information, not noise.

veg.label: Veg / non-veg
veg.note: The green or brown dot is mandatory on Indian packs and is the first thing many shoppers check.

ingredients_order.label: Ingredients recorded in declared order
ingredients_order.note: Order is the information. Sugar second on the list means something different from sugar tenth, so an ingredient list must never be sorted or deduplicated.

nova_group.label: NOVA processing group
nova_group.note: 1 unprocessed to 4 ultra-processed. A published classification from the ingredient list, not our judgement — recorded with its source.

sanity.no_scores: No health scores, no 'good for you', no traffic lights. We publish sugar per 100 g and let the reader decide. NOVA is recorded because it is a published classification with a method, not an opinion of ours.
sanity.crowd_sourced: Open Food Facts records come from phone scans and vary in quality. A record with no product name, or with neither ingredients nor nutrition, is a candidate — never an entry.
sanity.quantity_required: Nutrition per 100 g is meaningless for comparison without knowing what you are buying. No quantity, no entry.
